about.heading: About Me
about.bio: I'm a full-stack developer who loves building products that make a difference. From sleek web apps to performant mobile experiences, I enjoy working across the entire stack. I'm passionate about clean code, modern design patterns, and the developer experience.
about.bioExtended: When I'm not coding, you'll find me swimming laps, cycling through the city, or grinding ranks in BGMI. I'm a huge advocate for AI-powered development tools and believe the future of coding is collaborative — humans and AI building together.
